title: How You Can Find Hope After Hitting Rock Bottom

In this episode, Dana is joined by Aaron Ryan, a best-selling author who has navigated the highs and lows of a creative career. Aaron shares his deeply personal journey, from his early days in the toxic "Illuminati" of the voiceover world to the devastating breakdown that became his greatest breakthrough. He reveals the story of hitting rock bottom, crying on his bathroom floor, and clinging to the one quote that kept him going: "The temptation to quit is always greatest just before your greatest success." Aaron offers invaluable wisdom on overcoming imposter syndrome, the profound joy of holding your creation in your hands, and why hope is the most powerful tool for any artist.
